name: seldon
description: Seldon's own marketplace, so the plugin can be installed straight from this repository.

plugins.name: seldon
plugins.description: A Claude Code plugin that does the design work before Cadence builds. It interviews you about what you want to build, then writes a brief, a PRD, an architecture spine and a set of epics into .planning/seldon/, so Cadence starts from fixed boundaries and small phases.
